{{Quote|I'm Vana Sage, second in command of security here in Keren. If you need some credits, I'm very short-handed right now. A Rodian pilot just landed, and I need someone to check his cargo permits. Interested?|Vana Sage|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Jeepfal Nareedo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Vana Sage]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with checking his cargo permits. However, when it turned out that the permits were not in order, Nareedo attacked the spacer, only to be subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ToughThugMaleRodianTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Jeepfal Nareedo]]
Jeepfal Nareedo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Jeepfal Nareedo spawned under the generic "thug_rodian_male" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible male Rodian depictions. While the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue confirmed Nareedo to be a male Rodian, it did not mention his physical characteristics. Therefore, it cannot be definitively determined which of the two depictions is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. However, this article assumes that because both depictions had the same [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and skin color, that those characteristics are canon in the Legends continuity.<ref name="AED" />
